translation: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai
mein qasam khata hun qayamat kay din ki ,
aur qasam khata hun malamat kernay walay nafs ki ,   ( kay hum insan ko zaroor dobara zinda keren gay )
kiya insan yeh samajh raha hai kay hum uss ki haddiyon ko ikattha nahi ker-saken gay-?
kiyon nahi-? jabkay hamen iss per bhi qudrat hai kay uss ki ungliyon kay por por ko theek theek bana den .
asal baat yeh hai kay insan chahta yeh hai kay apni aagay ki zindagi mein bhi dhitai say gunah kerta rahey .
poochtay hai kay :  kab aaye ga woh qayamat ka din ?
phir jab aankhen chundhiya jayen gi ,
aur chaand bey noor hojaye ga ,
aur chaand aur sooraj ikatthay ker diye jayen gay ,
uss waqt insan kahey ga kay :  kahan hai koi jagah jahan bhag ker jaon ?
nahi nahi ! panah ki koi jagah nahi hogi .
uss din to her aik ko tumharay perwerdigar hi kay samney jaker thehrna parray ga .
uss din her insan ko jatla diya jaye ga kay uss ney kiya kuch aagay bheja hai , aur kiya kuch peechay chorra hai .
balkay insan khud apney aap say achi tarah waqif hoga ,
chahye woh kitney bahaney banaye .
. ( aey payghumber ! ) tum iss Quran ko jaldi jaldi yaad kernay kay liye apni zaban ko hilaya naa kero .
yaqeen rakho kay iss ko yaad kerana aur parhwana humari zimma daari hai ,
phir jab hum issay ( jibraeel kay wastay say ) parh rahey hon to tum iss kay parhney ki perwi kero .
phir uss ki wazahat bhi humari zimma daari hai .
. khabrdar ( aey kafiro ! ) asal baat yeh hai kay tum fori tor per hasil honey wali cheez ( yani duniya ) say mohabbat kertay ho ,
aur aakhirat ko nazar andaz kiye huye ho .
uss din boht say chehray shadab hon gay ,
apney perwerdigar ki taraf dekh rahey hon gay ,
aur boht say chehray uss din bigrey huye hon gay ,
samajh rahey hon gay kay unn kay sath woh moamla hoga jo kamar torr denay wala hai .
khabrdar ! jab jaan hansliyon tak phonch jaye gi ,
aur ( teemar daaron ki taraf say ) kaha jaye ga kay :  hai koi jhaarr phoonk kernay wala-?
aur insan samajh jaye ga kay judai ka waqt aagaya ,
aur pindli say pindli lipat jaye gi
to uss din tumharay perwerdigar hi ki taraf rawangi hogi .
iss kay bawajood insan ney naa maana , aur naa namaz parhi ,
balkay haq ko jhutlaya , aur mun morr liya ,
phir akarr dikhata huwa apney ghar walon kay paas chala gaya .
barbadi hai teri , haan barbadi hai teri !
phir sunn ley kay barbadi hai teri , haan barbadi hai teri !
kiya insan yeh samajhta hai kay ussay yunhi chorr diya jaye ga-?
kiya woh uss mani ka aik qatra nahi tha jo ( maa kay reham mein ) tapkaya jata hai ?
phir woh aik loathra bana , phir Allah ney ussay banaya , aur ussay theek thaak kiya ,
neez ussi say mard aur aurat ki do sinfen banayen ,
kiya woh iss baat per qadir nahi hai kay murdon ko phir say zinda kerday-?
